dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and smooth 2D tapering from the mid-dorsal section toward the visible posterior region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity off-white to pale grey with a subtle cool-toned color cast.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary dorsal plane and the darker lateral margins submerged in the water column.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, thin, elongated longitudinal light-colored linear mark is visible on the right dorsal quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single longitudinal linear scar or rake mark running parallel to the spinal axis on the right side of the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark, transverse crescent-shaped aperture visible at the blowhole location.
